units: <cite ref="Berakhot 59a">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אימת מתחזי בטִיהֲרֵיה</he> Ms. M. (ed. only <he>אימתי</he>) when is the sky seen in its brightness?—Pl. <he>טִיהֲרִין</he>, <cite ref="I00318"><he>טִהֲ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 4:11">Targ. Jer. IV, 11</cite> <he>רוח ט׳</he> a clearing, sweeping wind (h. text <cite ref="R00266"><he>צח</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: (cmp. Targ. Jer. l. c.) cold wind, cold (cmp. אִסְתָּנָא). Lam. R. introd. (R. Joh. 1) בט׳ ובקייטא in cold weather and in summer heat.
